scope: Kaby i5-8250U Qwen3/Qwen2.5 Q8_0 no-bias dense-linear selector dry run after SLM-CPU-190
claim_boundary: SLM-CPU-191 is a dry-run receipt/audit surface only; it does not implement, select, or enable a no-bias dense-linear fast path.
Eligible decisions only identify future candidates whose role evidence is bias_present=false and whose strict receipt identity matches policy requirements.
Blocked decisions remain fail-closed, including all Qwen2.5 attention q_proj, k_proj, and v_proj roles with bias_present=true.
No allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, Q4/Q5 runtime support, server, GPU/NPU/OpenVINO/UHD 620, Qwen3.5, or BitNet QK256 behavior is claimed.

summary.blanket_no_bias_selector_blocker: Qwen2.5 attention q_proj, k_proj, and v_proj have bias_present=true.

recommended_next_item.summary: Implement a disabled-by-default no-bias dense-linear selector audit hook only after before/after receipts can prove unchanged generated IDs and strict identity.

must_not_claim: A no-bias dense linear fast path is implemented or selected by default.
Generated IDs, decoded text, prompt IDs, model SHA, tokenizer source, backend/kernel identity, or fallback status change.
Allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, broad decode latency, prefill latency, model-load latency, or warm-session end-to-end speedup is proven.
Q4_K_M or Q4_K_S runtime support exists.
Server, GPU, NPU, OpenVINO, or UHD 620 execution is involved.
Qwen3.5 or hybrid architecture support is in scope.
